name: Ashish Ahuja
player_statement:
A complete player, Ashish Ahuja has made a big mark in cricket. With 17 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 32*, with an average of 12.80 and a quick strike rate of 110.34. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 6 sixes and 20 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 39.3 overs, taking 15 wickets at an economy rate of 6.81. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
